segments.name: EXTEND
segments.description: Japan-based reportable segment operating in Japan under a different regulatory environment than the other subsidiaries.
segments.evidence: EXTEND operates in Japan, which is subject to different regulatory environment than other subsidiaries which operate in the PRC and Hong Kong.

segments.name: Other subsidiaries
segments.description: Reportable segment made up of the group's other subsidiaries, which operate in Hong Kong and the PRC.
segments.evidence: As a result of the assessment made by CODMs, the Group has two reportable segments, including EXTEND from Japan, and other subsidiaries from Hong Kong and PRC.

changes.text: The HQT Company was closed down and its business line discontinued in 2025.
changes.evidence: the Company closed down HQT Company in April 2025 and discontinued the corresponding business line.

changes.text: The TikTok live stream guild business was suspended in 2025.
changes.evidence: However, the Company suspended its TikTok live stream guild business in 2025, and currently only retains the cross-border e-commerce software services provided for two clients.
